title: Saturday on your water
meta: November 9 – November 15, 2026 · November fundamentals · All coasts · 15 of 15 waters · this week’s waters
letter: November has a rule: Texas flounder are closed the entire month. Do not keep one. Reds still peak. Drum arrive with the first real front. Keys bones like the cooler water. Andros winter singles begin, which is why people book this week in March. Long leaders. Soft landings. Fewer boats.
disclaimer: Wind, sky, and the water. Not a bite. Not for navigation.

peaks.name: Redfish
peaks.theaters: Texas · Louisiana · Florida · North Carolina · South Carolina
peaks.why: Texas and Louisiana main event. Tails in flooded grass, wakes on shell, winter schools on mud, bulls in the passes. Keys: backcountry only, not oceanside. Boca Harbor yes. Jupiter is a snook desk.

peaks.name: Speckled trout
peaks.theaters: Texas · Louisiana · North Carolina · South Carolina
peaks.why: Same bays as the red, a foot deeper. Birds are GPS. Heat drives them off the flat at midday. Cold drives them to guts and mud. Louisiana lives on this fish.

peaks.name: Southern flounder
peaks.theaters: Texas · Louisiana · North Carolina · South Carolina
peaks.why: Fall migration to the Gulf when water drops a few degrees. Males leave first. Spring return. Texas closed Nov 1–Dec 14. Louisiana typically closed Oct 15–Nov 30 — verify LDWF.

peaks.name: Bonefish
peaks.theaters: Florida · Bahamas · Mexico · Puerto Rico · Seychelles
peaks.why: Absent in Texas. Keys: big, few, educated. Bahamas: the capital — winter singles, summer schools of 3–5 lb fish. Puerto Rico: east islands more than San Juan. Seychelles: Alphonse and Farquhar sand, not Mahé town water.

peaks.name: Gag grouper
peaks.theaters: Florida · Texas · North Carolina · South Carolina
peaks.why: Florida Gulf wrecks and the Big Bend rocks. Texas has him farther offshore than a bay brief. Not a Keys hogfish.

peaks.name: Florida pompano
peaks.theaters: Texas · Louisiana · Florida · North Carolina · South Carolina
peaks.why: Surf and clean sand. Texas and Florida beaches in the cool months. Not a permit. Not a jack.

peaks.name: Greater amberjack
peaks.theaters: Texas · Louisiana · Florida · Bahamas · Mexico · Puerto Rico · North Carolina · South Carolina
peaks.why: Gulf and Atlantic wrecks. Not a jack crevalle. Not a GT. Do not headline a flat with an AJ.

peaks.name: Giant trevally
peaks.why: Indo-Pacific. Alphonse, St François, Farquhar — the reason the atoll week exists. Absent from the Atlantic and the Gulf. Do not print a GT on Galveston or Condado.

closures.title: Texas flounder
closures.body: Closed Nov 1–Dec 14. The fall run is real in October. This week the correct fish is a red or a trout.

closures.title: Louisiana flounder
closures.body: Typically closed Oct 15–Nov 30. LDWF, not TPWD. Verify the week you keep one.
